description: Form 8582-CR Part IV: 'No modified adjusted gross income limitation applies' to low-income housing credits for property placed in service after 1989. Wages $300,000, an $8,000 specified low-income housing credit from a rental. Line 35 = tax on 284,250 ($69,034.75) less tax on 259,250 ($60,284.75) = 8,750 ≥ 8,000: all allowed. Form 3800 line 29 = (69,034.75 − 11,008.69) − 0 = 58,026.06, so the $8,000 specified credit is allowed.
